text:
Maya (AE): Hey team — AcmeBank POC kickoff. Need to lock scope + success criteria for live demo on 2026-03-27. Customer goal: speed up AML alert triage (summarization + rationale + disposition suggestions). Can we pick the 3 endpoints we will show, 3 eval prompts, timeline, and a ballpark pricing/security stance for POC? I can nudge them for test data later.

Jamal (SE): +1. My proposal for endpoints (minimal):
- POST /triage/summarize  -> short summary of alert
- POST /triage/rationale  -> concise reasons (bulleted)
- POST /triage/suggest_action -> suggested disposition (escalate / close / monitor)

Example payload:
```
{
  "alert_id": "A-1234",
  "transactions": [ {"ts":"2026-03-01T12:00Z","amt":12500,"ccy":"USD"}, ... ],
  "notes": "user-reported multiple card-not-present txns"
}
```

Li (POC Lead): Solid. Prioritization I'd push: 1) summarize (demoable), 2) suggest_action (business value), 3) rationale (harder but good for trust). Suggested acceptance criteria for POC:
- Latency: P95 < 600ms for single-request demo traffic
- Throughput: sustain 50 req/s for 5min soak without errors
- Quality: on seeded eval set, disposition accuracy >= 85% and summary conciseness >= 0.8 (we'll do pairwise human checks)
- Stability: <1% 5xx errors during test window

Evals: propose 100 labeled alerts (seed) + 200 blind cases. Jamal + I will own the harness; need customer to provide 120 labeled cases by 2026-03-22 to tune prompts.

Olivia (CS): Customer requires anonymization and no persistent retention of PII. They also asked whether we can do VPC-to-VPC or Dedicated if they need logs isolated. They're asking for SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence and a short checklist for the security questionnaire. I'll own coordination with legal.

Evan (Security): For the questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 report and network diagram. For POC options:
- Hosted API (fastest): request-side redaction + ephemeral logs (30d) and provide audit log extracts
- Dedicated: full isolation, logs shipped to their S3/SIEM
Note: confirm whether alerts include ePHI — if yes, we'll need extra controls. I'll draft answers for the vendor form by EOD.

Jamal (SE): Pricing ballpark for the POC (assume 1M tokens across tests and demo):
- Hosted API: ~$1,500 - $3,000 depending on model family and streaming
- Dedicated (monthly trial): requires minimum commit, ballpark $12k/month for a small pool (includes support)
We can reduce cost with 8-bit quantized model for suggest_action; summarization should stay higher fidelity.

Maya (AE): Good. Action items:
- Maya: ask customer for 120 labeled + 80 blind by 2026-03-22
- Jamal + Li: build eval harness and seed prompts; draft 10 example prompts per endpoint by 2026-03-20
- Olivia: request SOC2 + ISO docs, confirm retention preference
- Evan: complete security questionnaire draft by EOD
- Jamal: prepare pricing slide with hosted vs dedicated + cost savings from quantization

Li (POC Lead): I'll also prepare 3 canonical prompts per endpoint and a short prompt-engineering checklist (temperature, max_tokens, stop sequences). Example prompt for summarize:
```
Prompt: "Summarize this AML alert in 2 sentences, highlight top 3 risk factors, and list confidence 0-1"
Params: {"temperature":0.0, "max_tokens":120}
```

Olivia (CS): I'll confirm whether they need contract-level DPA before POC. If yes, that may push timelines by ~3 business days. Also customer asked: can we disable analytics collection for POC? Answer: yes, via opt-out flag.

Jamal (SE): Quick technical note: for latency testing use sequence length cap 1024 tokens; enable KV-cache for repeated prompt patterns. Canary model for POC: model-v1.2-q8 (if quality ok) else fallback to model-v1.2.

Maya (AE): Ok all — please react with :thumbsup: when you own an item. I'll assemble a one-pager for the customer after we have the final acceptance criteria.

Li (POC Lead): :thumbsup: I'll take eval harness + prompts.
Jamal (SE): :thumbsup: I'll do pricing slide + infra notes.
Olivia (CS): :thumbsup: I'll collect SOC2 and DPA status.
Evan (Security): :thumbsup: I'll start the questionnaire.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: model-v1.2-q8 -> sales-demo-cluster at 2026-03-24T09:00Z

Maya (AE): Thanks — will update customer once we have the labeled cases. If anything blocks, ping me or DM.
